# Vantio Optics

> Public manual version 1 for Vantio Optics. Free local metadata for supported AI-agent calls. CLI `@vantio/cli@0.3.24` is the frozen published CLI. PyPI `vantio-agent-sdk` is 3.0.14. Python 3.1.0 in git is unpublished. Contract `unstable-pre-1.0`. Optics observes. Enforcement is Phantom Engine, outside this manual.

Installable behavior is CLI 0.3.24 and Python 3.0.14. Do not describe unpublished 3.1.0 source as `pip install`.

## Start here

- [AI guide](AI-GUIDE.md): commands you may cite, tokens you must preserve, telemetry split, no invented coverage
- [Version metadata](VERSION-METADATA.json): registry versions and source commit
- [User manual](USER-MANUAL.md): full public manual
- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md): demo, Node wrap, Python wrap
- [Telemetry](TELEMETRY.md): CLI opt-in; published Python 3.0.14 `shield()` sends unless disabled; `hosts` means customer LLM endpoint hostnames

## Rules for answers

- Use this manual version. Do not invent commands.
- Do not claim Optics blocks, redacts, or caps spend.
- Do not infer coverage. A missing record is `NOT_OBSERVED`.
- Preserve `UNKNOWN`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `PARTIAL`, `NOT_OBSERVED`, and the other status tokens.
- Point enforcement questions to Phantom Engine docs. Do not write those docs from this tree.
- Do not document SQLite, a UI, alerting, OTLP, a stable schema, or PKG-02 as present.
- Do not use Sight Loop as the product name. A stored `workflow` string `sight_loop` is leftover.
- Examples marked illustrative are not transcripts.
